ja298:1.1: Udumbarā c' ime pakkā nigrodhā ca kapitthanā, ehi nikkhama bhuñjassu, kiṃ jighacchāya mīyasīti.
ja298:2.1: Evaṃ so sukhito hoti yo vaddham apacāyati yathāham ajja suhito dumapakkāni-m-āsito ti.
ja298:3.1: Yaṃ vanejo vanejassa vañceyya kapino kapi daharo pi taṃ na saddheyya na hi jiṇṇo jarākapīti.
